decoy_engine/execution/_chunked_output_s.reason: casts a chunk onto the sink's own writer schema, which the writer built; the output writer strips metadata again at publish

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_batc.reason: child-key staging batch built from a key-only schema; internal scratch that is never published

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_emit.reason: rebuilds a batch on fixed_schema, which _fixed_output_schema already passed through attach_output_metadata

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_join.reason: child-key staging batch on a key-only schema; internal scratch that is never published

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_rela.reason: relation staging batch on a schema this module builds from key types; internal scratch that is never published

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_stag.reason: masked-key stage batch on the stager's own key schema; internal scratch that is never published

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_stre.reason: raw parent spill batch built from the source column order; private spill file, never published
same-object rebuild: replaces one column of result and keeps the schema result already had
child-key spill batch on the joiner's own key schema; internal scratch that is never published
empty batch on the spill reader's own key schema; internal scratch that is never published
